members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both rewrite the same trailing-slash normalization in buildWellKnownPath (and buildDiscoveryUrls) to fix malformed discovery paths like '/foo//.well-known/...'. #2214 only patches the two path-builder functions with a bare regex strip. #2215 makes the identical regex change via a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper and additionally updates shouldAttemptFallback's root check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` — required because once trailing slashes are stripped, a root pathname becomes '' rather than '/', so shouldAttemptFallback's old '/' sentinel would never match and root-like paths would trigger a redundant extra fallback request. Landing #2214 alone leaves that inconsistency; #2215 is the superset fix that keeps path normalization and fallback-decision logic in sync.
